Extend the existing character naturally DOWNWARD to mid-thigh and slightly outward if needed so neither arm is cropped. The missing lower torso and hips must continue the existing anatomy and clothes, not a stretched copy of the existing bottom edge. Do not redesign or beautify the person. Preserve facial features especially eye spacing, brow, nose, jaw and age. Continue the same off-white laboratory coat over dark clothes. One complete head-to-mid-thigh game dialogue cutout, portrait canvas, true alpha background, no ground shadow, no text or grid. This change is only to supply missing lower-body image coverage for a consistent dialogue camera; retain the existing identity and expression.

Edit target: this anonymous dark game dialogue silhouette. Extend its existing torso naturally downward to mid-thigh, including the existing arms and hands at the sides.
